requirement: The Help strip is as wide as the chat box, and a Help row is drawn once after a host command opens the transcript

oracle.ref: PR #1039 (fix); fix evidence: 08/10/2026: after typing /help and Enter the suggested questions and the Discord link sat off the chat box. Evidence: tasks/bang-chung/lan-6-help-thang-hang-o-chat/KET-QUA.md. Second defect found while re-checking: after /compact then /help <q> every Help row was drawn twice (strip and transcript); measured tips 2, questions 2 before, tips 1, questions 1 after.
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0'; the case "the Help strip is as wide as the chat box" is 'ok': .tv-help-dock takes its max-width from --dsh-composer-card-max-width plus twice --dsh-composer-side-clearance, pads by the clearance plus 16px, and has no fixed pixel max-width. S3: at every width the first suggested question starts 16px inside the chat box card (before: +59px at 1440, -17px at 1200, -44px at 1000). S1 also: 'a host command opened the transcript (an active target) while the session is still blank: the strip steps aside' is 'ok'. S4: one question row and one Tip row (before: two of each, the second answer cut at the top), and no Help row inside the strip.
